meta.name: related-skill
meta.description: Discover and install related skills from inference.sh skill registry. Helps find complementary skills for your AI workflow. Use for: skill discovery, workflow expansion, capability exploration. Triggers: related skills, find skills, skill discovery, complementary skills, expand workflow, more capabilities, similar skills, skill suggestions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索、列出并安装来自 inference.sh 技能仓库的互补技能，从而扩展自身能力。
howto.when: 当用户要求发现相关技能、查找技能或扩展工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索图像生成相关的技能。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, list, and install complementary skills from the inference.sh skill registry to expand its capabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to discover related skills, find skills, or expand workflow.

say_en.note: Claude will execute the search and return results.
Claude will run the install command.
